hero.title: RSSHub Balancer
hero.summary: Load balancer for multiple RSSHub instances — prefers upstream caches and tries other instances when a request fails.

usage.title: How to Use
usage.bodyBeforeExample: Use this site like any regular RSSHub instance: append an RSSHub route after this domain, for example
usage.bodyAfterExample: . If you already use another RSSHub instance, replace only the domain in your feed URL and keep the path and query string unchanged.

trafficSankey.title: Request Flow in the Last 24 Hours
trafficSankey.summary: Regular feed proxy requests recorded by the origin and standby environments, grouped by source country or region, RSSHub path prefix, and final result. Each recorded request counts once; retries do not add to the count. Successful requests flow to the responding upstream; failed requests share a single Request failed node. Only the first path segment (for example, /github) is recorded; later segments and query strings are excluded. Link widths show approximate request counts, excluding requests served directly from Cloudflare cache.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.introStrong: prefers cached content and skips recent failures
howItWorks.introAfter: to help reuse existing content and keep feeds available:

runtime.title: One address with automatic failover
runtime.body: — The origin normally handles RSS requests, while Cloudflare Workers serves this homepage and takes over subsequent requests after scheduled checks confirm a service failure. Traffic returns to the origin once it recovers and passes the checks. Your feed URLs stay the same.

cacheAware.title: Cache-aware routing
cacheAware.body: — Before forwarding, the balancer checks candidate instances in parallel for a cached copy of the route and randomly selects from any cache hits to help reuse existing content. Upstream RSSHub instances remain responsible for fetching content and updating their caches.

retry.title: Retries and temporary failure avoidance
retry.body: — If an upstream times out or returns an error response, other candidates are tried in sequence. Instances that recently failed for the same path are temporarily skipped. If no candidate is available, the request returns an error.

compatibility.title: Endpoint Compatibility
compatibility.summary: Differences from the original RSSHub endpoints:

feed.notes: GET/HEAD supported; prefers upstream caches and tries other candidates on failure

home.notes: This page, replaces the original RSSHub homepage

healthz.notes: Returns ok if at least one current upstream is healthy; otherwise returns 503

robots.notes: Asks search engines not to crawl this site

routeStatus.notes: Checks if any upstream has cached the given route

metrics.notes: Returns 404; request flow is shown in the homepage chart for the last 24 hours
